editorial:
Imagine you are a young filmmaker trying to bring back a dead horror series from the 80s. That is exactly where you start with this wild ride. You follow an ambitious director who tracks down the original star of the franchise, a guy who has been hiding from the world for decades. At first, it feels like a funny movie about movie making, but things get weird fast. The vibe shifts from a quirky comedy to a scary nightmare as the line between the fake movie world and real life starts to blur. You will feel the tension build as the director realizes the man she is interviewing might be way more dangerous than the character he played years ago.

The acting is top notch and the twists will actually catch you off guard. While the middle part drags a little bit, the bloody finale makes up for it. If you love movies that play with your head, you need to see this.
endingExplained: You find out that the reclusive star has actually been killing people to recreate the plots of his old movies in real life. The director realizes she was never meant to make a sequel, but was actually the final victim in his own twisted game. In the end, she manages to trick him using a camera trap, leading to his death. She survives, but she is left scarred and obsessed with the horror she witnessed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror movies that don't take themselves too seriously.
